see_for_yourself.expected: Your Gravatar or initials show top-right, cello appears in the member list, clashes work without another Google screen, and typing the name lands you as that member.
steps: Remove the app's Google access first, then open a test group's invite link in a private tab
Sign in with Google, allow Calendar, join with the name filled in, and add cello from the corner menu
In a fresh private window on the laptop, type the name of a name-only member to get back in
see_for_yourself.title: Join from your phone

what_just_landed.detail: A picture in the top-right corner of every page opens your name and instrumentation for the group, a link to change the picture, and sign in or out.
what_just_landed.title: Your profile menu

what_just_landed.detail: Signing in with Google, now also on the invite page, asks for Calendar access in the same step, so clashes and calendar writing work straight away.
what_just_landed.title: One Google sign-in

what_just_landed.detail: Name-only members type their name on the invite page to return on a new device; several with the same name are offered as a list.
what_just_landed.title: Getting back in by name
